outcomes.name: health check answers ok
outcomes.expect: Criterion 1: `GET /health` answers 200 with JSON saying status "ok".

outcomes.name: filled: orders list shows all five orders in id order
outcomes.expect: Criterion 2: `GET /api/orders` answers 200 with a JSON array of all five orders in the id order above, each with id, customer, item and total (id and total as numbers).

outcomes.name: filled: an empty or missing q lists all five orders
outcomes.expect: Criterion 6: An empty or missing `q` returns all five orders.

outcomes.name: filled: search finds a customer by part of the name
outcomes.expect: Criterion 3: `GET /api/orders?q=alice` returns only orders whose customer name contains the text (checked on a text that matches one customer name and no item).

outcomes.name: filled: search ignores case and surrounding spaces
outcomes.expect: Criterion 3: Case and surrounding spaces do not matter: `q=%20ALICE%20` returns the same two (checked on texts that match one customer name and no item).

outcomes.name: filled: search lists every order of a customer
outcomes.expect: Criterion 3: `GET /api/orders?q=alice` returns only orders whose customer name contains the text (1001 and 1003). Case and surrounding spaces do not matter: `q=%20ALICE%20` returns the same two.

outcomes.name: empty: a search that matches nothing is an empty list, not an error
outcomes.expect: Criterion 5: When nothing matches (for example `q=zed`), the answer is 200 with an empty JSON array, not an error.

outcomes.name: empty: search does not look at item words
outcomes.expect: Criterion 4: `q` looks at customer names only: an item word returns an empty array (checked on item words that occur in one item and no customer name).

outcomes.name: empty: the item word from the ticket finds nothing
outcomes.expect: Criterion 4: `q` looks at customer names only: `q=desk`, an item word, returns an empty array.

outcomes.name: filled: one order opens by its id
outcomes.expect: Criterion 7: `GET /api/orders/1004` answers 200 with that one order (Chidi Okafor, Webcam, 120) as a JSON object.

outcomes.name: error: an unknown order id is a 404 order not found
outcomes.expect: Criterion 8: `GET /api/orders/9999` answers 404 with the message "order not found".

outcomes.name: error: a non-numeric order id is a client error
outcomes.expect: Criterion 9: A non-numeric id such as `/api/orders/abc` is rejected with a 4xx client error, never a 200 or a 500.
